svg.title: Kubernetes Disaster Recovery Platform — AWS Solution Architecture
svg.desc: AWS architecture diagram using AWS service icon artwork. It illustrates one region with VPC, EKS, Flask, PostgreSQL, EBS, Velero, S3, and EBS snapshot flow. Validate live resources and restore evidence separately.
svg.text: Solution architecture • single AWS region • eu-central-1
Amazon VPC • public/private subnet layout in two AZs
Managed control plane and worker nodes
Velero writes backup objects to S3 and uses configured EBS snapshot support
Verify plugin, permissions, storage locations and backup phase
VPC • IAM / IRSA • EKS • EBS CSI • S3 • ECR
Diagram describes the target design. Verify live deployment and restore evidence before claiming a successful drill or measured RTO/RPO.
Official AWS Architecture Icons • https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/ • editable SVG preview with AWS icon artwork
